lines: Commits on track/p-config-form after the coordinator's rebase onto main: d7edfa4 feat(admin-auth), 6ebaa3c feat(admin-config), 38e1642 fix(admin-config) (rebased, not rewritten), then 5b62b7b fix(admin-auth): bind confirmations to their changes, count failures (review M1-M3). Not pushed or landed.

REVIEW FIX M1 (content binding): POST /v1/admin/auth/confirm-password body is now {password, action: app_config.publish, body: {config, expectedVersion?}}. The server parses body with the publish schema (routes/appConfigPublishTarget.ts, shared by both routes; defaults and trims applied) and stores sha256 of the canonical {config, expectedVersion} (appConfigPublishHash = the idempotency request hash) as request_sha256. Consume matches it; a different body is 400 TOKEN_INVALID 'given for different changes' and nothing is consumed. reason is not bound (audit text only, also outside the idempotency hash).

M1 migration: 076 edited in place to add request_sha256 bytea NOT NULL with an octet_length = 32 check. 076 has never run outside test containers (track never landed or deployed); if it was applied on dev, it must move to 077 as a nullable column.

M1 contracts: AdminConfirmationToken, ConfirmedAdminMutationHeaders, ADMIN_CONFIRMATION_ERRORS, ADMIN_CONFIRMATION_HEADER moved to admin-shared.ts (avoids an admin-content <-> admin-step-up import cycle); new AdminAppConfigPublishTarget in admin-content.ts; AdminPasswordConfirmationBody gains body. OpenAPI regenerated; generated frontend operations unchanged.

M1 frontend: the screen confirms {config: checks.payload, expectedVersion: editedFrom}, the exact draft reviewed, then publishes the same plus reason. CONFIRMATION_REFUSED copy adds 'or was given for other changes'.

REVIEW FIX M2 (failures only): src/auth/confirmationAttemptLimiter.ts, in-process, 5 per 15 min per admin. reserve() before the hash check (throws RATE_LIMITED at 5; counting before the async hash stops parallel guesses racing past it), release() after a success or any error other than INVALID_CREDENTIALS. Sign-in counters (user_credentials failed_attempt_*) untouched. Still per process and reset on restart (coordinator: accepted as before).

REVIEW FIX M3 tests: confirm-password by a support-role admin (no config.publish) with wrong and right password -> 403 both, no step-up audit, no token rows; same idempotency key with a different body -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, token stays unconsumed, then publishes under a new key; stale refusal leaves version count, current config and published audits equal and the token unconsumed.

Tests now: adminStepUp.integration 11 (was 7): + body binding, + stale writes nothing (replaces the old stale test, which became impossible under binding), + different-body replay, + permission, + successes do not count. adminAppConfigPublish.integration now confirms each body it publishes and uses the real limiter (successes no longer count).

Unchanged from the first hand-off: tokens 256-bit, HMAC-stored, 5 min, bound to user+session+action (now also request); consumed inside the idempotent tx after the receipt check; old admin apps get 403 AUTHORIZATION_DENIED 'Update the admin app to publish app config.' (existing code; a new one reads as 'unrecognised error' in released apps); CORS allows x-admin-confirmation.

Coordinator owns: nginx maintenance Allow-Headers (x-admin-confirmation) in the 4 release_manager/nginx site configs, DEPLOY.md notes, plan note that 076 is expand-only. Lows L1-L6 left as the review lists them. Required app-update announcement still raises the Android minimum without a password step (doubtful, unchanged).

EMULATOR (admin APK on dev after deploy with 076): App config shows the form sections and a closed Advanced fold; Android 0.19.0 -> amber lock-out warning; add presentation entry qaCheck = 1, Advanced JSON shows it and edits flow back; Review and publish lists the change, wrong password -> 'That password is not right.', right password publishes (version +1); audit shows auth.step_up_refused, auth.step_up_confirmed, app_config.published with stepUpId; remove qaCheck and publish again to restore.

EMULATOR extra (M2): after a publish, make 6 more harmless publishes in a row (e.g. toggle qaCheck) with the right password: none is refused. 5 wrong passwords then the right one -> 'Too many tries. Wait N minutes, then try again.' (locks that admin out of publishing for up to 15 minutes; optional).

Commits (base 324c332, not pushed or landed): 6c108ec feat(admin-auth): require a password confirmation to publish app config; 9317ba9 feat(admin-config): edit app config as a form with a password step; 4135763 fix(admin-config): call a too-short password wrong, not a validation fault.

BACKEND: POST /v1/admin/auth/confirm-password (routes/adminStepUpRoutes.ts, domain/auth/adminStepUp.ts, repositories/adminStepUpRepository.ts). Admin web (cookie+CSRF) and admin native (bearer) via resolveAdminPrincipal; needs config.publish. Body {password, action: app_config.publish}.

Verify like webLogin: hash read without lock, Argon2 off the connection, dummy verify when no credential, hash re-checked inside the write tx. Limiter: a dedicated createPasswordRecheckLimiter (5 per 15 min per admin, in-process, hit before verification, so wrong and right attempts count). Login itself has no lockout (026 notes); this is the recheck style.

Audit: auth.step_up_confirmed (entity admin_step_up_confirmation, same tx as the token row); auth.step_up_refused (entity user) in its own tx so it survives; app_config.published metadata gains stepUpId. No password in audit, logs (body redacted, headers not serialised) or rows (test asserts rowsMentioning = 0).

Token: 32 random bytes base64url (43 chars), returned once with cache-control no-store, stored only as HMAC-SHA256 under the token hash key (crypto.generateVerificationToken), 5-min expiry, bound to user_id + session_id + action.

Migration 076_admin_step_up_confirmations.sql: new table, unique token_hash, expiry index, checks; expand-only, previous release runs against it untouched. No pruning yet (rows are tiny and rare; the index makes a later prune cheap).

PUBLISH: PATCH /v1/admin/app-config requires x-admin-confirmation (adminRouteKit.requireAdminConfirmation, checked before body parse). Consumption is a conditional UPDATE (consumed_at null, expires_at > now, user, session, action) inside runAdminMutation's execute, i.e. after the idempotency receipt check: replay with same key returns the stored result; a refused publish (stale version) rolls the consumption back; a concurrent second use waits on the row lock and then finds it consumed.

Errors: missing header -> 403 AUTHORIZATION_DENIED 'Update the admin app to publish app config.'; malformed or not bound to this user/session -> 400 TOKEN_INVALID; used -> 409 TOKEN_ALREADY_USED; expired -> 410 TOKEN_EXPIRED. CORS allows x-admin-confirmation (needed by the APK preflight).

COMPAT (rule 11, finding-14): released admin builds v0.14.7, v0.15.4, v0.17.0, v0.18.2 all show error.message verbatim under 'Not published' for any known code except VALIDATION_FAILED and (from 0.17) STATE_CONFLICT. readError falls back to isErrorCode, so a NEW code becomes INTERNAL_ERROR 'The server returned an unrecognised error.' Hence existing AUTHORIZATION_DENIED: known everywhere, non-retryable, 403 but not CSRF_INVALID (would trigger CSRF recovery+resend), not 401 (refresh/end session), not STATE_CONFLICT (old screen shows 'configuration changed').

COMPAT: only publishAdminAppConfig changes for old admin apps; every other admin op and all client ops unchanged. Response shapes unchanged; new audit command/entity strings are z.string() in every released audit contract. Client apps never call any of this (admin channels only).

COMPAT, rollback: images-only rollback to 0.18.2 leaves 076 unused. An 0.18.3 admin APK against a rolled-back backend cannot publish config (confirm-password 404 shows 'The requested resource was not found' in the dialog); everything else works.

FRONTEND (features/admin/app-config): form with Feature flags (onlinePayments switch in plain words, absent = shown on as the client reads it; unknown flags kept, removable; Add a flag), Minimum app version (X.Y.Z, update message 500, warning when above baseVersion(buildVersion())), Downloads (https only), Maintenance (switch, message 8000, planned start datetime-local in India time -> '...+05:30'), Presentation (typed rows, add/remove), Advanced JSON fold synced both ways, whole draft checked with contracts AdminAppConfigPayload.

Review and publish: dialog lists changed keys vs the loaded version, repeats the lock-out warning, password field (type password, autocomplete current-password, cleared after submit). Confirmation token rides in the held write body (not persisted to storage), so Check again resends same key and token. Load the published version and stale refusal unchanged.

Honest copy: iOS/web minimums and download addresses are not read by any released app today (verified: publicAppRoutes reads only minimumSupportedVersion.android; no reader of downloads); the form says so.

TESTS (rule 10): test/integration/adminStepUp.integration.test.ts 7 tests: no token refused 403 + nothing written; confirmed publish + replay returns stored result + stepUpId audit; reuse 409; expiry boundary (5 min - 5 s ok, + 1 s 410); bound to session (other admin and owner's second session 400); stale refusal leaves token usable; wrong password 401 x5 audited, 6th with right password 429, no password in rows.

TESTS updated on purpose: adminAppConfigPublish.integration (confirm first; 'released admin apps' titles reworded; generous limiter there), cors.test (header), clientErasureCoverage ACTOR_FKS (admin_step_up_confirmations.user_id), releaseUpgrade list (+076), frontend funds/heldWrites.test.tsx app-config row now goes through the password step. New frontend AppConfigBuilderScreen.test.tsx (2): form -> exact JSON -> back, publishes that JSON + token; warning on form and in review.
